stem: Which clinical feature is notably absent in a typical presentation of Food Protein-Induced Enterocolitis Syndrome (FPIES)?
explanation: FPIES is a non-IgE mediated disorder and specifically does not involve the skin or respiratory tract.
rationale: Distinguish between IgE-mediated symptoms and those of non-IgE mediated enterocolitis.

optionExplanations.A: FPIES is a non-IgE mediated disorder and specifically does not involve the skin or respiratory tract.
optionExplanations.B: This is the hallmark symptom of an acute FPIES reaction.
optionExplanations.C: These systemic features are common in FPIES and can lead to confusion with sepsis or severe infection.
optionExplanations.D: In severe cases, FPIES can cause these shock-like symptoms.

source.hint: Distinguish between IgE-mediated symptoms and those of non-IgE mediated enterocolitis.
